topics.name: cmd_vel_teleop
topics.description: Teleop velocity command (linear.x forward, linear.y left, angular.z turn left; each [-1, 1]) — the Gamepad in 6dof mode. Takes priority over cmd_vel_automated whenever a fresh teleop message has arrived within teleop_timeout_s.

topics.name: cmd_vel_automated
topics.description: Autonomy or scripted velocity command (linear.x forward, linear.y left, angular.z turn left; each [-1, 1]). Used only when no recent teleop message is present.

topics.name: front_left_motor
topics.description: Front-left wheel command, normalized to [-1, 1]: linear.x − linear.y − angular.z. Positive drives the robot forward.

topics.name: front_right_motor
topics.description: Front-right wheel command, normalized to [-1, 1]: linear.x + linear.y + angular.z. Positive drives the robot forward.

topics.name: back_left_motor
topics.description: Back-left wheel command, normalized to [-1, 1]: linear.x + linear.y − angular.z. Positive drives the robot forward.

topics.name: back_right_motor
topics.description: Back-right wheel command, normalized to [-1, 1]: linear.x − linear.y + angular.z. Positive drives the robot forward.

teleop_timeout_s.label: Teleop Timeout
teleop_timeout_s.description: Seconds without a teleop message before falling back to automated commands.
